paite: "Migilou-salou tatlekna in ka lungtang sung ah thu agen a, 'Amit ah Pathian kihtakna a-om kei,' chi in.
heading: David La / Mihing Gitlouhna

paite: Athulimlouhna amukhe kei ding ua, apai tuan kei ding uh, chi in. Amah mitmuh in akiphat tawm hi.
Akam a thupawtte thulimlouhna leh khemna thu gen ahi nak a; pil leh thil hoih hih atawpta ahi.
Alupna ah thil thulim lou agel gige a; lampi hoih lou ah apai teitei a; gilou akih kei hi.
TOUPA aw, na zahngaihna vante ah a-om a; na ginomna in meipite asu hi.
heading: Pathian Hoihna

paite: Na diktatna Pathian tangte bang ahi; na vaihawmte tui thuk talkhauh bang ahi; TOUPA aw, mihing leh gamsa na humbit hi.
"Pathian aw, na zahngaihna manpha hi na tel e! Mihing tate na kha nuai ah atu zel uhi.
Amau na insung thil hoih in atai ding ua; na kipahna lui ana dawnsak ding hi.
Hinna tuikhuk nang ah a-om a, na vak ah vak ka mu ding uhi.
"Aw, nangmah theite tung ah na zahngaihna kitheisak inla; lungtang diktak pute tung ah leng na diktatna langsak in.
Kisathei khe hon sual ding in kei lam ah kalsuan dah henla, migilou-salou khut in hon delhmang kei hen.
"Huai ah thulimlouhna hihte apuk ua; paihkhiak in a-om ua, athou thei nawn kei ding uhi."
